trap.label: told me to
trap.wrong: My mother told me that I take the keys.
trap.right: My mother told me to take the keys.
trap.why: Em português “mandou que eu pegasse” usa que + subjuntivo. Em inglês, tell + pessoa + to + verbo; também Past Perfect para o fato anterior.

mcq.q: He left after he ___ the work.

fix.right: When I arrived, he had left.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com should have: “You didn’t study. That was a mistake.”
Una: “He left. I arrived.” (Past Perfect, when)
rewrite.answer: He had left when I arrived.
